findings.title: Host lookup lowercases the column but not the input
findings.body: `record_for_host` compares `lower(host)` against `uri.host` without downcasing the input. The model does not normalize case on save, so a stored host like 'Example.com' only matches a referer if the referer's hostname is already lowercase. A mixed-case referer or embed URL is rejected even though hostnames are case-insensitive. Downcase the input value before querying.

findings.title: before_validation crashes on nil host
findings.body: The callback calls `self.host.sub!` with no nil check. If `params[:embeddable_host][:host]` is missing, or a record is built without a host, this raises NoMethodError and the request returns a 500 instead of a validation error.

findings.title: Migration crashes when embed_category is not set
findings.body: `execute(...)[0]['id']` assumes the join query returns a row. On sites with no `embed_category` setting, or one that names no existing category, `[0]` is nil and the migration raises NoMethodError, which blocks the deploy. The same problem exists at line 15 when `uncategorized_category_id` has no row in site_settings.

findings.title: Unescaped interpolation of host values into SQL
findings.body: Each old host value is interpolated directly into an INSERT statement without quoting. A value containing a quote breaks the migration and can inject SQL. The values are also not stripped or normalized, so entries with http://, a path, or trailing whitespace/CR are migrated as-is and will never match `host_allowed?`. Existing embeds would silently stop working after the upgrade.

findings.title: Unknown id causes NoMethodError instead of 404
findings.body: `update` and `destroy` use `where(...).first`, which returns nil for an unknown id. They then call methods on that nil, producing a 500 error. Use `find` (or an equivalent) so a missing record returns a 404.

findings.title: Validation rejects localhost and long TLDs
findings.body: The format regex requires a TLD of 2–5 letters. It rejects hosts such as `localhost`, IP addresses, and longer TLDs (e.g. .museum, .technology). Values the old setting allowed, possibly brought over by the migration, can no longer be saved.

findings.title: Displayed category is wrong when none is selected
findings.body: If no category is chosen, `categoryId` is null and the server saves the uncategorized category. The client instead sets `host.category` from `findById(null)`, so the row shows a blank category badge rather than the category the server actually stored.

findings.title: Fabricator file contents swapped
findings.body: category_fabricator.rb now defines `:embeddable_host`, while embeddable_host_fabricator.rb defines the category fabricators. The tests still work, but the file names are misleading for anyone looking for either fabricator.
